newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Treasury offers A$300 mln of notes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Treasury offers A$300 mln of notes.

text.p: The Australian Treasury will offer a total of A$300 million of Treasury notes for tender on Wednesday, the Reserve Bank of Australia said.
The tender offer consists of only 26-week notes, of which the RBA said it would take up an additional A$100 million for its own portfolio.
The Treasury last week offered a total of A$1.3 billion of notes, comprising A$500 million of five-week notes, A$400 million of 13-week notes and A$400 million of 26-week notes.
There are A$783 million of non-official holdings of T-notes maturing in the week ending November 21.
